conflicts.legacy_datamined_model: A June 2026 datamined wiki model described PQ 184 as the highest-numbered quest and 183 standalone missions because it treated PQ 36 as cut.
conflicts.current_post_chapter_4_sources: Steam, GameFAQs, and July 2026 gameplay coverage independently expose PQ 185 and PQ 186 as the two Chapter 4 quests, making 186 the current canonical highest quest number for this wiki.
conflicts.resolution: Keep PQ 36 in the numbered record set because the repository already contains an explicit PQ 36 record and current player-facing numbering proceeds through PQ 186. Preserve the historical cut-quest claim as provenance rather than deleting or renumbering records.

policy: Do not use the legacy 184-cap model as the site's final count. Track the datamined discrepancy as historical provenance until direct game-file extraction can settle the PQ 36 standalone-mission interpretation.
